purpose: Form CHG-1 is used for the registration of creation or modification of charges other than debentures, or for belated applications to the Registrar.
who: The company and the charge holder, or the charge-holder in case of default, or the insolvency resolution professional, resolution professional, or liquidator for companies under resolution or liquidation.
when: Within a period of thirty days of the date of creation or modification of charge, or within the period specified in section 77.
steps: Prepare particulars of the charge in Form No. CHG-1.
Include a copy of the instrument creating or modifying the charge.
Ensure the form is duly signed by the company and the charge holder, or by the insolvency resolution professional, resolution professional, or liquidator if under resolution or liquidation.
File the form with the Registrar along with the required fee.
checklist: Copy of the instrument creating or modifying the charge
Signatures of the company and the charge holder
Declaration from the company signed by its company secretary or a director for belated filings
attachments: A copy of the instrument creating or modifying the charge
Declaration from the company signed by its company secretary or a director for belated filings
watch: Belated filing declarations must state that the filing shall not adversely affect the rights of any other intervening creditors.
